name: Flow batteries (vanadium, zinc-bromine)
principle: Energy is stored in liquid electrolytes in tanks and pumped through a cell stack, so power and energy are sized separately. Invinity reports over 11,000 MWh discharged since 2022 and cites a 1.5 GWh vanadium project at Laufenburg, Switzerland; duration, cycle life and efficiency were not quantified on its page.

process_steps.name: Pumps circulate electrolyte through the stack
